content: Maicanda mas yali balic an nisha nira
Chi urasllaita pai japishca runaguna Jesusta tapunaura, Diospa ali mandanaibi auc runagunamanda maican runata yali balicca tucunga.
Tapucpi Jesus shuc huahuata cayasha paiguna chaupibi shayachira, chihuasha paigunata nira,
Sirtuta nini, canguna shuc huahuagunacuinta juchata mana yuyaric tucusha nisha, canguna yuyaita mana cambiashaga Diospa ali mandana muntunma mana yaicunguichichu.
Maican runas cai huahuacuinta mana alabaric ashaga Diospa ali mandanaibi yali balic tucungami.
Maican runahuas ñucahuagraicu cai huahuatashina llaquishcahuan japishaga ñucatami japihuanga.
Juchama apauc runamanda

Jesus mas rimara, Maican runahuas cai huahuatacuinta ñucata quiric runagunata juchata rachicpiga paihua cungaibi shuc jatun rumita huataitucusha jatun cucha ucuma shitanaupi chucacpi ali anma. Pai sirtu mas ashca turmintachishca tucungami.
Cai pachai juchata rachic runaguna sirtu tiyangaunami. Chasna acpi paigunamanda cai pacha llaqui taripaitucungami. Chi tunu rac runagunaga llaquita turmintaringaunami.

Chiraicu camba maqui, camba chaqui canda juchata rachicpiga chigunata pitisha caruma jichungui. Ishcai maquiyuc ishcai chaquiyuc ucupachama rinarandimanda pullu maquihuan pullu chaquihuan jahuapachama yaicunaga mas ali anga.
Chasnallata camba ñahuiga juchata canda rachicpiga chita surcusha caruma jichungui. Ishcai ñahuiyuc ucupachama rinarandimanda shuc ñahuillahuan jahuapachama yaicunaga mas ali anga.
Chingarishca ovejamanda
Jesus catisha rimara, Cai huahuagunamanda ama pitahuas ninguichichu mana balicchan nisha. Paigunahua jahuapacha angelgunaga tucui uras ñuca jahuapachai auc Yaya ñaupacpi tiyaunguna.
Ñáuca Runa Tucuc asha chingarishcacuinta tucushca runagunataga quishpichingahua shamurani.
Yuyarichi. Shuc runa patsac (100) ovejata charishcamanda shuc chingaricpiga manachu chi iscun chunga iscungunata (99) urcui saquinga chi chingarishcata mascagringahua.
Sirtumi nini, Chi mana chingarishca ovejagunamanda chi chingarishcata tupashaga yapa cushiyangami.
Chasnallata cangunahua jahuapachaibi auc Yayaga mana munanzhu cai ichillagunamanda mana shugllahuas chingarichun nisha.
Quiric huauquihuan alichinamanda
Camba quiric huauqui canda mana alita racpiga paihuan sapalla cuintagrisha alichingui. Canda uyacpi paita Diospacta cuti rangahua munachishcangui.

Canda mana uyacpi canhuan pariu shuc ali quiric runata u ishcaita paihuagma ña alichingahua apangui. Pai ima tucushcatas rimacpi uyasha chi ishcai (2) pura quimsa (3) pura alita yachasha alichinauchun nisha.

Randi pai cangunata mana cadsucpiga quiriccuna tandarishcai tucuita cuintangui. Chasna racpi tucui quiriccunatas pai mana cadsucpiga paita romano cullquita tandac runacuintata u jiridsata rac nishca tucunga.

Sirtuta nini, Cai pachaibi canguna huatashcacuinta maicandas mana alichan nicpiga jahuapachai Yaya Diospas mana alichaun ningami. Chasnallata cai pachaibi canguna imatas pascashcacuinta maicandahuas ali man nicpiga jahuapachaibis ali man ningami.
Chasnallata cangunata nini, maicanbas cangunamanda ishcai runaguna shuc yuyaillahuan imatas Diosta mañasha tapucpi ñuca jahuapachai tiyac Yaya canguna tapushcata cungami.
Maibi ishcai u quimsa runapura ñuca shutihuan tandaricpi paigunahuan ñuca tiyashami nira.
Huauquita perdunashcamanda
Jesus chasna rimacpi Pedro paima caillayasha tapura, Shuc quiric huauqui ñucata mana alita racpi masna cutinda perdunana ani, canzhis (7) cutingamachu perdunana ani.
Tapucpi Jesus cutipara, Canzhis cutingamalla mana ninichu, randi cadsi pichca patsac (500) mana yupaibaccama perdunana mangui.
Uyaichi. Diospa ali mandana shuc cullquiyuc amucuinta man. Shuc punzha chi amu paihua runaguna dihuishcagunata pagahuaichi nira.
Chasna nicpi shamura shuc runa ashca huaranga (10.000) cullquita dihuic.

Ima paganatas mana charicpi amu chi runata rimara camba dihui pagashca tucungahua camba huarmitas churigunatas tucui charishcagunatas candahuas randichishca tucungaraunguichi, pagashca saquirichun nisha.
Chita uyasha chi runaga amu ñaupacpi cungurisha rugara, Ama chasna rahuaichu señor nisha, chapahuangui, ñuca ansa ansa illacta pagashcanguimi.
Chasna rugacpi amu chi runata llaquisha saquira, pai dihuigunata illacta perdunara.

Chi runa chimanda llucshisha pariu tarabauc runahuan paita shuc patsacllata (100) dihuic runahuan tupanacura. Paihua cungamanda japisha quihuira, Can ñucata dihuishcata cunan pagahuai nisha sinzhi shimihuan caparira.
Chi runa cungurisha paita rugara, Ama chasna rahuaichu, ñapa chapapangui, tucuita pagashcanguimi nira.
Randi paiga mana uyasha mana perdunarachu. Chi dihuic runata japisha carcelbi tapara paihua dihuita paganagama.
Chasna tucushcata shuccuna ricusha, yapa llaquirisha, chi amuhuagma cuintagrinaura.
Chi cuintaucunata uyasha amu chi runata cayasha nira, Mana ali runachangui. Can dihuishcagunata huinda perdunasha saquirani can llaquilla rugashcamanda.
Cambas manachu canda dihuicta yuyarisha yanapana arangui ñuca canda yuyarisha yanapashcacuinta.
Chasna nisha amu sinzhita piñasha cai runata cachara libachinauchun nisha paihua dihuita tucuita paganagama.

Jesus chasna cuintashcahuasha nira, Chasnallata shuccuna cangunata mana ali rashcata tucui shunguhuan canguna mana perdunasha cungaricpiga ñuca jahuapachai auc Yaya cangunatas chi amu rashcacuintallata rangami.
